versos.hebraico: וְאַבְרָהָ֣ם זָקֵ֔ן בָּ֖א בַּיָּמִ֑ים וַֽיהוָ֛ה בֵּרַ֥ךְ אֶת־אַבְרָהָ֖ם בַּכֹּֽל׃

controles.web: Abraham was old, and well stricken in age. Yahweh had blessed Abraham in all things.
controles.kjv: And Abraham was old, and well stricken in age: and the Lord had blessed Abraham in all things.
controles.livre: E Abraão era velho, e cheio de dias; e o SENHOR havia abençoado a Abraão em tudo.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אַבְרָהָ֗ם אֶל־עַבְדּוֹ֙ זְקַ֣ן בֵּית֔וֹ הַמֹּשֵׁ֖ל בְּכָל־אֲשֶׁר־ל֑וֹ שִֽׂים־נָ֥א יָדְךָ֖ תַּ֥חַת יְרֵכִֽי׃

controles.web: Abraham said to his servant, the elder of his house, who ruled over all that he had, “Please put your hand under my thigh.
controles.kjv: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:
controles.livre: E disse Abraão a um criado seu, o mais velho de sua casa, que era o que governava em tudo o que tinha: Põe agora tua mão debaixo de minha coxa,

versos.hebraico: וְאַשְׁבִּ֣יעֲךָ֔ בַּֽיהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וֵֽאלֹהֵ֖י הָאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־תִקַּ֤ח אִשָּׁה֙ לִבְנִ֔י מִבְּנוֹת֙ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י יוֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: I will make you swear by Yahweh, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you shall not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I live.
controles.kjv: And I will make thee swear by the Lord, the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell:
controles.livre: E te juramentarei pelo SENHOR, Deus dos céus e Deus da terra, que não tomarás mulher para meu filho das filhas dos cananeus, entre os quais eu habito;

versos.hebraico: כִּ֧י אֶל־אַרְצִ֛י וְאֶל־מוֹלַדְתִּ֖י תֵּלֵ֑ךְ וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ אִשָּׁ֖ה לִבְנִ֥י לְיִצְחָֽק׃

controles.web: But you shall go to my country, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son Isaac.”
controles.kjv: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac.
controles.livre: Em vez disso irás à minha terra e à minha parentela, e tomarás mulher para meu filho Isaque.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ הָעֶ֔בֶד אוּלַי֙ לֹא־תֹאבֶ֣ה הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה לָלֶ֥כֶת אַחֲרַ֖י אֶל־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֑את הֶֽהָשֵׁ֤ב אָשִׁיב֙ אֶת־בִּנְךָ֔ אֶל־הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־יָצָ֥אתָ מִשָּֽׁם׃

controles.web: The servant said to him, “What if the woman isn’t willing to follow me to this land? Must I bring your son again to the land you came from?”
controles.kjv: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?
controles.livre: E o criado lhe respondeu: Talvez a mulher não queira vir atrás de mim a esta terra; farei voltar, pois, teu filho à terra de onde saíste?

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖יו אַבְרָהָ֑ם הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֔ פֶּן־תָּשִׁ֥יב אֶת־בְּנִ֖י שָֽׁמָּה׃

controles.web: Abraham said to him, “Beware that you don’t bring my son there again.
controles.kjv: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.
controles.livre: E Abraão lhe disse: Guarda-te que não faças voltar a meu filho ali.

versos.hebraico: יְהוָ֣ה׀ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם אֲשֶׁ֨ר לְקָחַ֜נִי מִבֵּ֣ית אָבִי֮ וּמֵאֶ֣רֶץ מֽוֹלַדְתִּי֒ וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּר־לִ֜י וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר נִֽשְׁבַּֽע־לִי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לְזַ֨רְעֲךָ֔ אֶתֵּ֖ן אֶת־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֑את ה֗וּא יִשְׁלַ֤ח מַלְאָכוֹ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ אִשָּׁ֛ה לִבְנִ֖י מִשָּֽׁם׃

controles.web: Yahweh, the God of heaven, who took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my birth, who spoke to me, and who swore to me, saying, ‘I will give this land to your seed.’ He will send his angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.
controles.kjv: The Lord God of heaven, which took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my kindred, and which spake unto me, and that sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence.
controles.livre: O SENHOR, Deus dos céus, que me tomou da casa de meu pai e da terra de minha parentela, e me falou e me jurou, dizendo: À tua descendência darei esta terra; ele enviará seu anjo diante de ti, e tu tomarás dali mulher para meu filho.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־לֹ֨א תֹאבֶ֤ה הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ לָלֶ֣כֶת אַחֲרֶ֔יךָ וְנִקִּ֕יתָ מִשְּׁבֻעָתִ֖י זֹ֑את רַ֣ק אֶת־בְּנִ֔י לֹ֥א תָשֵׁ֖ב שָֽׁמָּה׃

controles.web: If the woman isn’t willing to follow you, then you shall be clear from this oath to me. Only you shall not bring my son there again.”
controles.kjv: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son thither again.
controles.livre: E se a mulher não quiser vir atrás de ti, serás livre deste meu juramento; somente que não faças voltar ali a meu filho.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם הָעֶ֨בֶד֙ אֶת־יָד֔וֹ תַּ֛חַת יֶ֥רֶךְ אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֑יו וַיִּשָּׁ֣בַֽע ל֔וֹ עַל־הַדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּֽה׃

controles.web: The servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.
controles.kjv: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning that matter.
controles.livre: Então o criado pôs sua mão debaixo da coxa de Abraão seu senhor, e jurou-lhe sobre este negócio.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֣ח הָ֠עֶבֶד עֲשָׂרָ֨ה גְמַלִּ֜ים מִגְּמַלֵּ֤י אֲדֹנָיו֙ וַיֵּ֔לֶךְ וְכָל־ט֥וּב אֲדֹנָ֖יו בְּיָד֑וֹ וַיָּ֗קָם וַיֵּ֛לֶךְ אֶל־אֲרַ֥ם נַֽהֲרַ֖יִם אֶל־עִ֥יר נָחֽוֹר׃

controles.web: The servant took ten camels, of his master’s camels, and departed, having a variety of good things of his master’s with him. He arose, and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.
controles.kjv: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; for all the goods of his master were in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, unto the city of Nahor.
controles.livre: E o criado tomou dez camelos dos camelos de seu senhor, e foi-se, pois tinha à sua disposição todos os bens de seu senhor: e posto em caminho, chegou à Mesopotâmia, à cidade de Naor.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּבְרֵ֧ךְ הַגְּמַלִּ֛ים מִח֥וּץ לָעִ֖יר אֶל־בְּאֵ֣ר הַמָּ֑יִם לְעֵ֣ת עֶ֔רֶב לְעֵ֖ת צֵ֥את הַשֹּׁאֲבֹֽת׃

controles.web: He made the camels kneel down outside the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time that women go out to draw water.
controles.kjv: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening, even the time that women go out to draw water.
controles.livre: E fez ajoelhar os camelos fora da cidade, junto a um poço de água, à hora da tarde, à hora em que saem as moças por água.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּאמַ֓ר׀ יְהוָ֗ה אֱלֹהֵי֙ אֲדֹנִ֣י אַבְרָהָ֔ם הַקְרֵה־נָ֥א לְפָנַ֖י הַיּ֑וֹם וַעֲשֵׂה־חֶ֕סֶד עִ֖ם אֲדֹנִ֥י אַבְרָהָֽם׃

controles.web: He said, “Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, please give me success this day, and show kindness to my master Abraham.
controles.kjv: And he said, O Lord God of my master Abraham, I pray thee, send me good speed this day, and shew kindness unto my master Abraham.
controles.livre: E disse: SENHOR, Deus de meu senhor Abraão, dá-me, te rogo, o ter hoje bom encontro, e faze misericórdia com meu senhor Abraão.

versos.hebraico: הִנֵּ֛ה אָנֹכִ֥י נִצָּ֖ב עַל־עֵ֣ין הַמָּ֑יִם וּבְנוֹת֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י הָעִ֔יר יֹצְאֹ֖ת לִשְׁאֹ֥ב מָֽיִם׃

controles.web: Behold, I am standing by the spring of water. The daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water.
controles.kjv: Behold, I stand here by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water:
controles.livre: Eis que eu estou junto à fonte de água, e as filhas dos homens desta cidade saem por água:

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֣ה הַֽנַּעֲרָ֗ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֹמַ֤ר אֵלֶ֨יהָ֙ הַטִּי־נָ֤א כַדֵּךְ֙ וְאֶשְׁתֶּ֔ה וְאָמְרָ֣ה שְׁתֵ֔ה וְגַם־גְּמַלֶּ֖יךָ אַשְׁקֶ֑ה אֹתָ֤הּ הֹכַ֨חְתָּ֙ לְעַבְדְּךָ֣ לְיִצְחָ֔ק וּבָ֣הּ אֵדַ֔ע כִּי־עָשִׂ֥יתָ חֶ֖סֶד עִם־אֲדֹנִֽי׃

controles.web: Let it happen, that the young lady to whom I will say, ‘Please let down your pitcher, that I may drink,’ and she will say, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink,’—let her be the one you have appointed for your servant Isaac. By this I will know that you have shown kindness to my master.”
controles.kjv: And let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that thou hast shewed kindness unto my master.
controles.livre: Seja, pois, que a moça a quem eu disser: Baixa teu cântaro, te rogo, para que eu beba; e ela responder: Bebe, e também darei de beber a teus camelos: que seja esta a que tu destinaste para teu servo Isaque; e nisto conhecerei que haverás feito misericórdia com meu senhor.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְהִי־ה֗וּא טֶרֶם֮ כִּלָּ֣ה לְדַבֵּר֒ וְהִנֵּ֧ה רִבְקָ֣ה יֹצֵ֗את אֲשֶׁ֤ר יֻלְּדָה֙ לִבְתוּאֵ֣ל בֶּן־מִלְכָּ֔ה אֵ֥שֶׁת נָח֖וֹר אֲחִ֣י אַבְרָהָ֑ם וְכַדָּ֖הּ עַל־שִׁכְמָֽהּ׃

controles.web: Before he had finished speaking, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher on her shoulder.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que antes que ele acabasse de falar, eis que Rebeca, que havia nascido a Betuel, filho de Milca, mulher de Naor irmão de Abraão, a qual saía com seu cântaro sobre seu ombro.

versos.hebraico: וְהַֽנַּעֲרָ֗ טֹבַ֤ת מַרְאֶה֙ מְאֹ֔ד בְּתוּלָ֕ה וְאִ֖ישׁ לֹ֣א יְדָעָ֑הּ וַתֵּ֣רֶד הָעַ֔יְנָה וַתְּמַלֵּ֥א כַדָּ֖הּ וַתָּֽעַל׃

controles.web: The young lady was very beautiful to look at, a virgin, neither had any man known her. She went down to the spring, filled her pitcher, and came up.
controles.kjv: And the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.
controles.livre: E a moça era de muito belo aspecto, virgem, à que homem não havia conhecido; a qual desceu à fonte, e encheu seu cântaro, e se voltava.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֥רָץ הָעֶ֖בֶד לִקְרָאתָ֑הּ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הַגְמִיאִ֥ינִי נָ֛א מְעַט־מַ֖יִם מִכַּדֵּֽךְ׃

controles.web: The servant ran to meet her, and said, “Please give me a drink, a little water from your pitcher.”
controles.kjv: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher.
controles.livre: Então o criado correu até ela, e disse: Rogo-te que me dês a beber um pouco de água de teu cântaro.

versos.hebraico: וַתֹּ֖אמֶר שְׁתֵ֣ה אֲדֹנִ֑י וַתְּמַהֵ֗ר וַתֹּ֧רֶד כַּדָּ֛הּ עַל־יָדָ֖הּ וַתַּשְׁקֵֽהוּ׃

controles.web: She said, “Drink, my lord.” She hurried, and let down her pitcher on her hand, and gave him drink.
controles.kjv: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.
controles.livre: E ela respondeu: Bebe, meu senhor; e apressou-se a baixar seu cântaro sobre sua mão, e lhe deu a beber.

versos.hebraico: וַתְּכַ֖ל לְהַשְׁקֹת֑וֹ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר גַּ֤ם לִגְמַלֶּ֨יךָ֙ אֶשְׁאָ֔ב עַ֥ד אִם־כִּלּ֖וּ לִשְׁתֹּֽת׃

controles.web: When she had done giving him drink, she said, “I will also draw for your camels, until they have done drinking.”
controles.kjv: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw water for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.
controles.livre: E quando acabou de dar-lhe de beber, disse: Também para teus camelos tirarei água, até que acabem de beber.

versos.hebraico: וַתְּמַהֵ֗ר וַתְּעַ֤ר כַּדָּהּ֙ אֶל־הַשֹּׁ֔קֶת וַתָּ֥רָץ ע֛וֹד אֶֽל־הַבְּאֵ֖ר לִשְׁאֹ֑ב וַתִּשְׁאַ֖ב לְכָל־גְּמַלָּֽיו׃

controles.web: She hurried, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again to the well to draw, and drew for all his camels.
controles.kjv: And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw water, and drew for all his camels.
controles.livre: E apressou-se, e esvaziou seu cântaro no bebedouro, e correu outra vez ao poço para tirar água, e tirou para todos os seus camelos.

versos.hebraico: וְהָאִ֥ישׁ מִשְׁתָּאֵ֖ה לָ֑הּ מַחֲרִ֕ישׁ לָדַ֗עַת הַֽהִצְלִ֧יחַ יְהוָ֛ה דַּרְכּ֖וֹ אִם־לֹֽא׃

controles.web: The man looked steadfastly at her, remaining silent, to know whether Yahweh had made his journey prosperous or not.
controles.kjv: And the man wondering at her held his peace, to wit whether the Lord had made his journey prosperous or not.
controles.livre: E o homem estava maravilhado dela, permanecendo calado, para saber se o SENHOR havia prosperado ou não sua viagem.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר כִּלּ֤וּ הַגְּמַלִּים֙ לִשְׁתּ֔וֹת וַיִּקַּ֤ח הָאִישׁ֙ נֶ֣זֶם זָהָ֔ב בֶּ֖קַע מִשְׁקָל֑וֹ וּשְׁנֵ֤י צְמִידִים֙ עַל־יָדֶ֔יהָ עֲשָׂרָ֥ה זָהָ֖ב מִשְׁקָלָֽם׃

controles.web: As the camels had done drinking, the man took a golden ring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold,
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold;
controles.livre: E foi que quando os camelos acabaram de beber, presenteou-lhe o homem um pendente de ouro que pesava meio siclo, e dois braceletes que pesavam dez;

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ בַּת־מִ֣י אַ֔תְּ הַגִּ֥ידִי נָ֖א לִ֑י הֲיֵ֧שׁ בֵּית־אָבִ֛יךְ מָק֥וֹם לָ֖נוּ לָלִֽין׃

controles.web: and said, “Whose daughter are you? Please tell me. Is there room in your father’s house for us to lodge in?”
controles.kjv: And said, Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee: is there room in thy father’s house for us to lodge in?
controles.livre: E disse: De quem és filha? Rogo-te me digas, há lugar em casa de teu pai onde possamos passar a noite?

versos.hebraico: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו בַּת־בְּתוּאֵ֖ל אָנֹ֑כִי בֶּן־מִלְכָּ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָלְדָ֖ה לְנָחֽוֹר׃

controles.web: She said to him, “I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor.”
controles.kjv: And she said unto him, I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, which she bare unto Nahor.
controles.livre: E ela respondeu: Sou filha de Betuel, filho de Milca, o qual deu à luz ela a Naor.

versos.hebraico: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו גַּם־תֶּ֥בֶן גַּם־מִסְפּ֖וֹא רַ֣ב עִמָּ֑נוּ גַּם־מָק֖וֹם לָלֽוּן׃

controles.web: She said moreover to him, “We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.”
controles.kjv: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.
controles.livre: E acrescentou: Também há em nossa casa palha e muita forragem, e lugar para passar a noite.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקֹּ֣ד הָאִ֔ישׁ וַיִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ לַֽיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: The man bowed his head, and worshiped Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And the man bowed down his head, and worshipped the Lord.
controles.livre: O homem então se inclinou, e adorou ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ אֲדֹנִ֣י אַבְרָהָ֔ם אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא־עָזַ֥ב חַסְדּ֛וֹ וַאֲמִתּ֖וֹ מֵעִ֣ם אֲדֹנִ֑י אָנֹכִ֗י בַּדֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ נָחַ֣נִי יְהוָ֔ה בֵּ֖ית אֲחֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽי׃

controles.web: He said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken his loving kindness and his truth toward my master. As for me, Yahweh has led me on the way to the house of my master’s relatives.”
controles.kjv: And he said, Blessed be the Lord God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I being in the way, the Lord led me to the house of my master’s brethren.
controles.livre: E disse: Bendito seja o SENHOR, Deus de meu senhor Abraão, que não afastou sua misericórdia e sua verdade de meu senhor, guiando-me o SENHOR no caminho à casa dos irmãos de meu senhor.

versos.hebraico: וַתָּ֨רָץ֙ הַֽנַּעֲרָ֔ וַתַּגֵּ֖ד לְבֵ֣ית אִמָּ֑הּ כַּדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

controles.web: The young lady ran, and told her mother’s house about these words.
controles.kjv: And the damsel ran, and told them of her mother’s house these things.
controles.livre: E a moça correu, e fez saber na casa de sua mãe estas coisas.

versos.hebraico: וּלְרִבְקָ֥ה אָ֖ח וּשְׁמ֣וֹ לָבָ֑ן וַיָּ֨רָץ לָבָ֧ן אֶל־הָאִ֛ישׁ הַח֖וּצָה אֶל־הָעָֽיִן׃

controles.web: Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban. Laban ran out to the man, to the spring.
controles.kjv: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the well.
controles.livre: E Rebeca tinha um irmão que se chamava Labão, o qual correu fora ao homem, à fonte;

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֣י׀ כִּרְאֹ֣ת אֶת־הַנֶּ֗זֶם וְֽאֶת־הַצְּמִדִים֮ עַל־יְדֵ֣י אֲחֹתוֹ֒ וּכְשָׁמְע֗וֹ אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֞י רִבְקָ֤ה אֲחֹתוֹ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כֹּֽה־דִבֶּ֥ר אֵלַ֖י הָאִ֑ישׁ וַיָּבֹא֙ אֶל־הָאִ֔ישׁ וְהִנֵּ֛ה עֹמֵ֥ד עַל־הַגְּמַלִּ֖ים עַל־הָעָֽיִן׃

controles.web: When he saw the ring, and the bracelets on his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, “This is what the man said to me,” he came to the man. Behold, he was standing by the camels at the spring.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spake the man unto me; that he came unto the man; and, behold, he stood by the camels at the well.
controles.livre: E foi que quando viu o pendente e os braceletes nas mãos de sua irmã, que dizia, Assim me falou aquele homem; veio a ele: e eis que estava junto aos camelos à fonte.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר בּ֖וֹא בְּר֣וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה לָ֤מָּה תַעֲמֹד֙ בַּח֔וּץ וְאָנֹכִי֙ פִּנִּ֣יתִי הַבַּ֔יִת וּמָק֖וֹם לַגְּמַלִּֽים׃

controles.web: He said, “Come in, you blessed of Yahweh. Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.”
controles.kjv: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of the Lord; wherefore standest thou without? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.
controles.livre: E disse-lhe: Vem, bendito do SENHOR; por que estás fora? eu limpei a casa, e o lugar para os camelos.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֹ֤א הָאִישׁ֙ הַבַּ֔יְתָה וַיְפַתַּ֖ח הַגְּמַלִּ֑ים וַיִּתֵּ֨ן תֶּ֤בֶן וּמִסְפּוֹא֙ לַגְּמַלִּ֔ים וּמַ֨יִם֙ לִרְחֹ֣ץ רַגְלָ֔יו וְרַגְלֵ֥י הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The man came into the house, and he unloaded the camels. He gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who were with him.
controles.kjv: And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men’s feet that were with him.
controles.livre: Então o homem veio à casa, e Labão desatou os camelos; e deu-lhes palha e forragem, e água para lavar os pés dele, e os pés dos homens que com ele vinham.

versos.hebraico: ויישם לְפָנָיו֙ לֶאֱכֹ֔ל וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א אֹכַ֔ל עַ֥ד אִם־דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי דְּבָרָ֑י וַיֹּ֖אמֶר דַּבֵּֽר׃

controles.web: Food was set before him to eat, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told my message.”   He said, “Speak on.”
controles.kjv: And there was set meat before him to eat: but he said, I will not eat, until I have told mine errand. And he said, Speak on.
controles.livre: E puseram diante dele comida; mas ele disse: Não comerei até que tenha dito minha mensagem. E ele lhe disse: Fala.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּאמַ֑ר עֶ֥בֶד אַבְרָהָ֖ם אָנֹֽכִי׃

controles.web: He said, “I am Abraham’s servant.
controles.kjv: And he said, I am Abraham’s servant.
controles.livre: Então disse: Eu sou criado de Abraão;

versos.hebraico: וַיהוָ֞ה בֵּרַ֧ךְ אֶת־אֲדֹנִ֛י מְאֹ֖ד וַיִּגְדָּ֑ל וַיִּתֶּן־ל֞וֹ צֹ֤אן וּבָקָר֙ וְכֶ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֔ב וַעֲבָדִם֙ וּשְׁפָחֹ֔ת וּגְמַלִּ֖ים וַחֲמֹרִֽים׃

controles.web: Yahweh has blessed my master greatly. He has become great. He has given him flocks and herds, silver and gold, male servants and female servants, and camels and donkeys.
controles.kjv: And the Lord hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR abençoou muito a meu senhor, e ele se engrandeceu: e lhe deu ovelhas e vacas, prata e ouro, servos e servas, camelos e asnos.

versos.hebraico: וַתֵּ֡לֶד שָׂרָה֩ אֵ֨שֶׁת אֲדֹנִ֥י בֵן֙ לַֽאדֹנִ֔י אַחֲרֵ֖י זִקְנָתָ֑הּ וַיִּתֶּן־לּ֖וֹ אֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Sarah, my master’s wife, bore a son to my master when she was old. He has given all that he has to him.
controles.kjv: And Sarah my master’s wife bare a son to my master when she was old: and unto him hath he given all that he hath.
controles.livre: E Sara, mulher de meu senhor, deu à luz em sua velhice um filho a meu senhor, quem lhe deu tudo quanto tem.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּשְׁבִּעֵ֥נִי אֲדֹנִ֖י לֵאמֹ֑ר לֹא־תִקַּ֤ח אִשָּׁה֙ לִבְנִ֔י מִבְּנוֹת֙ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י יֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּאַרְצֽוֹ׃

controles.web: My master made me swear, saying, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I live,
controles.kjv: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell:
controles.livre: E meu senhor me fez jurar, dizendo: Não tomarás mulher para meu filho das filhas dos cananeus, em cuja terra habito;

versos.hebraico: אִם־לֹ֧א אֶל־בֵּית־אָבִ֛י תֵּלֵ֖ךְ וְאֶל־מִשְׁפַּחְתִּ֑י וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ אִשָּׁ֖ה לִבְנִֽי׃

controles.web: but you shall go to my father’s house, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son.’
controles.kjv: But thou shalt go unto my father’s house, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son.
controles.livre: Em vez disso irás à casa de meu pai, e à minha parentela, e tomarás mulher para meu filho.

versos.hebraico: וָאֹמַ֖ר אֶל־אֲדֹנִ֑י אֻלַ֛י לֹא־תֵלֵ֥ךְ הָאִשָּׁ֖ה אַחֲרָֽי׃

controles.web: I asked my master, ‘What if the woman will not follow me?’
controles.kjv: And I said unto my master, Peradventure the woman will not follow me.
controles.livre: E eu disse: Talvez a mulher não queira me seguir.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑י יְהוָ֞ה אֲשֶׁר־הִתְהַלַּ֣כְתִּי לְפָנָ֗יו יִשְׁלַ֨ח מַלְאָכ֤וֹ אִתָּךְ֙ וְהִצְלִ֣יחַ דַּרְכֶּ֔ךָ וְלָקַחְתָּ֤ אִשָּׁה֙ לִבְנִ֔י מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתִּ֖י וּמִבֵּ֥ית אָבִֽי׃

controles.web: He said to me, ‘Yahweh, before whom I walk, will send his angel with you, and prosper your way. You shall take a wife for my son of my relatives, and of my father’s house.
controles.kjv: And he said unto me, The Lord, before whom I walk, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father’s house:
controles.livre: Então ele me respondeu: O SENHOR, em cuja presença tenho andado, enviará seu anjo contigo, e fará teu caminho ser bem-sucedido; e tomarás mulher para meu filho de minha linhagem e da casa de meu pai;

versos.hebraico: אָ֤ז תִּנָּקֶה֙ מֵאָ֣לָתִ֔י כִּ֥י תָב֖וֹא אֶל־מִשְׁפַּחְתִּ֑י וְאִם־לֹ֤א יִתְּנוּ֙ לָ֔ךְ וְהָיִ֥יתָ נָקִ֖י מֵאָלָתִֽי׃

controles.web: Then will you be clear from my oath, when you come to my relatives. If they don’t give her to you, you shall be clear from my oath.’
controles.kjv: Then shalt thou be clear from this my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give not thee one, thou shalt be clear from my oath.
controles.livre: Então serás livre de meu juramento, quando houveres chegado à minha linhagem; e se não a derem a ti, serás livre de meu juramento.

versos.hebraico: וָאָבֹ֥א הַיּ֖וֹם אֶל־הָעָ֑יִן וָאֹמַ֗ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ אֲדֹנִ֣י אַבְרָהָ֔ם אִם־יֶשְׁךָ־נָּא֙ מַצְלִ֣יחַ דַּרְכִּ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י הֹלֵ֥ךְ עָלֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: I came this day to the spring, and said, ‘Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, if now you do prosper my way which I go—
controles.kjv: And I came this day unto the well, and said, O Lord God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go:
controles.livre: Cheguei, pois, hoje à fonte, e disse: SENHOR, Deus de meu senhor Abraão, se tu fazes bem-sucedido agora meu caminho pelo qual ando;

versos.hebraico: הִנֵּ֛ה אָנֹכִ֥י נִצָּ֖ב עַל־עֵ֣ין הַמָּ֑יִם וְהָיָ֤ה הָֽעַלְמָה֙ הַיֹּצֵ֣את לִשְׁאֹ֔ב וְאָמַרְתִּ֣י אֵלֶ֔יהָ הַשְׁקִֽינִי־נָ֥א מְעַט־מַ֖יִם מִכַּדֵּֽךְ׃

controles.web: behold, I am standing by this spring of water. Let it happen, that the maiden who comes out to draw, to whom I will say, “Please give me a little water from your pitcher to drink,”
controles.kjv: Behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin cometh forth to draw water, and I say to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher to drink;
controles.livre: Eis que eu estou junto à fonte de água; seja, pois, que a virgem que sair por água, à qual disser: Dá-me de beber, te rogo, um pouco de água de teu cântaro;

versos.hebraico: וְאָמְרָ֤ה אֵלַי֙ גַּם־אַתָּ֣ה שְׁתֵ֔ה וְגַ֥ם לִגְמַלֶּ֖יךָ אֶשְׁאָ֑ב הִ֣וא הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־הֹכִ֥יחַ יְהוָ֖ה לְבֶן־אֲדֹנִֽי׃

controles.web: and she will tell me, “Drink, and I will also draw for your camels,”—let her be the woman whom Yahweh has appointed for my master’s son.’
controles.kjv: And she say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels: let the same be the woman whom the Lord hath appointed out for my master’s son.
controles.livre: E ela me responder, Bebe tu, e também para teus camelos tirarei água: esta seja a mulher que destinou o SENHOR para o filho de meu senhor.

versos.hebraico: אֲנִי֩ טֶ֨רֶם אֲכַלֶּ֜ה לְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל־לִבִּ֗י וְהִנֵּ֨ה רִבְקָ֤ה יֹצֵאת֙ וְכַדָּ֣הּ עַל־שִׁכְמָ֔הּ וַתֵּ֥רֶד הָעַ֖יְנָה וַתִּשְׁאָ֑ב וָאֹמַ֥ר אֵלֶ֖יהָ הַשְׁקִ֥ינִי נָֽא׃

controles.web: Before I had finished speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah came out with her pitcher on her shoulder. She went down to the spring, and drew. I said to her, ‘Please let me drink.’
controles.kjv: And before I had done speaking in mine heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the well, and drew water: and I said unto her, Let me drink, I pray thee.
controles.livre: E antes que acabasse de falar em meu coração, eis que Rebeca saía com seu cântaro sobre seu ombro; e desceu à fonte, e tirou água; e lhe disse: Rogo-te que me dês de beber.

versos.hebraico: וַתְּמַהֵ֗ר וַתּ֤וֹרֶד כַּדָּהּ֙ מֵֽעָלֶ֔יהָ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁתֵ֔ה וְגַם־גְּמַלֶּ֖יךָ אַשְׁקֶ֑ה וָאֵ֕שְׁתְּ וְגַ֥ם הַגְּמַלִּ֖ים הִשְׁקָֽתָה׃

controles.web: She hurried and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink.’ So I drank, and she also gave the camels a drink.
controles.kjv: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: so I drank, and she made the camels drink also.
controles.livre: E prontamente baixou seu cântaro de cima de si, e disse: Bebe, e também a teus camelos darei a beber. E bebi, e deu também de beber a meus camelos.

versos.hebraico: וָאֶשְׁאַ֣ל אֹתָ֗הּ וָאֹמַר֮ בַּת־מִ֣י אַתְּ֒ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר בַּת־בְּתוּאֵל֙ בֶּן־נָח֔וֹר אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָֽלְדָה־לּ֖וֹ מִלְכָּ֑ה וָאָשִׂ֤ם הַנֶּ֨זֶם֙ עַל־אַפָּ֔הּ וְהַצְּמִידִ֖ים עַל־יָדֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: I asked her, and said, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ She said, ‘The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bore to him.’ I put the ring on her nose, and the bracelets on her hands.
controles.kjv: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter art thou? And she said, The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bare unto him: and I put the earring upon her face, and the bracelets upon her hands.
controles.livre: Então lhe perguntei, e disse: De quem és filha? E ela respondeu: Filha de Betuel, filho de Naor, que Milca lhe deu. Então pus nela um pendente sobre seu nariz, e braceletes sobre suas mãos;

versos.hebraico: וָאֶקֹּ֥ד וָֽאֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה וָאֲבָרֵ֗ךְ אֶת־יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ אֲדֹנִ֣י אַבְרָהָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִנְחַ֨נִי֙ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ אֱמֶ֔ת לָקַ֛חַת אֶת־בַּת־אֲחִ֥י אֲדֹנִ֖י לִבְנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: I bowed my head, and worshiped Yahweh, and blessed Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter for his son.
controles.kjv: And I bowed down my head, and worshipped the Lord, and blessed the Lord God of my master Abraham, which had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter unto his son.
controles.livre: E inclinei-me, e adorei ao SENHOR, e bendisse ao SENHOR, Deus de meu senhor Abraão, que me havia guiado pelo caminho de verdade para tomar a filha do irmão de meu senhor para seu filho.

versos.hebraico: וְ֠עַתָּה אִם־יֶשְׁכֶ֨ם עֹשִׂ֜ים חֶ֧סֶד וֶֽאֱמֶ֛ת אֶת־אֲדֹנִ֖י הַגִּ֣ידוּ לִ֑י וְאִם־לֹ֕א הַגִּ֣ידוּ לִ֔י וְאֶפְנֶ֥ה עַל־יָמִ֖ין א֥וֹ עַל־שְׂמֹֽאל׃

controles.web: Now if you will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me. If not, tell me, that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.”
controles.kjv: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.
controles.livre: Agora, pois, se vós fazeis misericórdia e verdade com meu senhor, declarai-o a mim; e se não, declarai-o a mim; e irei embora à direita ou à esquerda.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֨עַן לָבָ֤ן וּבְתוּאֵל֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ מֵיְהוָ֖ה יָצָ֣א הַדָּבָ֑ר לֹ֥א נוּכַ֛ל דַּבֵּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖יךָ רַ֥ע אוֹ־טֽוֹב׃

controles.web: Then Laban and Bethuel answered, “The thing proceeds from Yahweh. We can’t speak to you bad or good.
controles.kjv: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing proceedeth from the Lord: we cannot speak unto thee bad or good.
controles.livre: Então Labão e Betuel responderam e disseram: Do SENHOR saiu isto; não podemos falar-te mal nem bem.

versos.hebraico: הִנֵּֽה־רִבְקָ֥ה לְפָנֶ֖יךָ קַ֣ח וָלֵ֑ךְ וּתְהִ֤י אִשָּׁה֙ לְבֶן־אֲדֹנֶ֔יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Behold, Rebekah is before you. Take her, and go, and let her be your master’s son’s wife, as Yahweh has spoken.”
controles.kjv: Behold, Rebekah is before thee, take her, and go, and let her be thy master’s son’s wife, as the Lord hath spoken.
controles.livre: Eis aí Rebeca diante de ti; toma-a e vai-te, e seja mulher do filho de teu senhor, como o disse o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמַ֛ע עֶ֥בֶד אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֶת־דִּבְרֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ אַ֖רְצָה לַֽיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: When Abraham’s servant heard their words, he bowed himself down to the earth to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham’s servant heard their words, he worshipped the Lord, bowing himself to the earth.
controles.livre: E foi, que quando o criado de Abraão ouviu suas palavras, inclinou-se à terra ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיּוֹצֵ֨א הָעֶ֜בֶד כְּלֵי־כֶ֨סֶף וּכְלֵ֤י זָהָב֙ וּבְגָדִ֔ים וַיִּתֵּ֖ן לְרִבְקָ֑ה וּמִ֨גְדָּנֹ֔ת נָתַ֥ן לְאָחִ֖יהָ וּלְאִמָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: The servant brought out jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing, and gave them to Rebekah. He also gave precious things to her brother and her mother.
controles.kjv: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to Rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.
controles.livre: E o criado tirou objetos de prata, objetos de ouro e roupas, e deu a Rebeca: também deu coisas preciosas a seu irmão e a sua mãe.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּאכְל֣וּ וַיִּשְׁתּ֗וּ ה֛וּא וְהָאֲנָשִׁ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־עִמּ֖וֹ וַיָּלִ֑ינוּ וַיָּק֣וּמוּ בַבֹּ֔קֶר וַיֹּ֖אמֶר שַׁלְּחֻ֥נִי לַֽאדֹנִֽי׃

controles.web: They ate and drank, he and the men who were with him, and stayed all night. They rose up in the morning, and he said, “Send me away to my master.”
controles.kjv: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said, Send me away unto my master.
controles.livre: E comeram e beberam ele e os homens que vinham com ele, e dormiram; e levantando-se de manhã, disse: Autorizai-me voltar a meu senhor.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אָחִ֨יהָ֙ וְאִמָּ֔הּ תֵּשֵׁ֨ב הַנַּעֲרָ֥ אִתָּ֛נוּ יָמִ֖ים א֣וֹ עָשׂ֑וֹר אַחַ֖ר תֵּלֵֽךְ׃

controles.web: Her brother and her mother said, “Let the young lady stay with us a few days, at least ten. After that she will go.”
controles.kjv: And her brother and her mother said, Let the damsel abide with us a few days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.
controles.livre: Então respondeu seu irmão e sua mãe: Espere a moça conosco ao menos dez dias, e depois irá.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ אַל־תְּאַחֲר֣וּ אֹתִ֔י וַֽיהוָ֖ה הִצְלִ֣יחַ דַּרְכִּ֑י שַׁלְּח֕וּנִי וְאֵלְכָ֖ה לַֽאדֹנִֽי׃

controles.web: He said to them, “Don’t hinder me, since Yahweh has prospered my way. Send me away that I may go to my master.”
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing the Lord hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.
controles.livre: E ele lhes disse: Não me detenhais, pois que o SENHOR fez prosperar meu caminho; despede-me para que me vá a meu senhor.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ נִקְרָ֣א לַֽנַּעֲרָ֑ וְנִשְׁאֲלָ֖ה אֶת־פִּֽיהָ׃

controles.web: They said, “We will call the young lady, and ask her.”
controles.kjv: And they said, We will call the damsel, and enquire at her mouth.
controles.livre: Eles responderam então: Chamemos a moça e perguntemos a ela.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְרְא֤וּ לְרִבְקָה֙ וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יהָ הֲתֵלְכִ֖י עִם־הָאִ֣ישׁ הַזֶּ֑ה וַתֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלֵֽךְ׃

controles.web: They called Rebekah, and said to her, “Will you go with this man?”   She said, “I will go.”
controles.kjv: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.
controles.livre: E chamaram a Rebeca, e disseram-lhe: Irás tu com este homem? E ela respondeu: Sim, irei.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְשַׁלְּח֛וּ אֶת־רִבְקָ֥ה אֲחֹתָ֖ם וְאֶת־מֵנִקְתָּ֑הּ וְאֶת־עֶ֥בֶד אַבְרָהָ֖ם וְאֶת־אֲנָשָֽׁיו׃

controles.web: They sent away Rebekah, their sister, with her nurse, Abraham’s servant, and his men.
controles.kjv: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham’s servant, and his men.
controles.livre: Então deixaram ir a Rebeca sua irmã, e à sua criada, e ao criado de Abraão e a seus homens.

versos.hebraico: וַיְבָרֲכ֤וּ אֶת־רִבְקָה֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְרוּ לָ֔הּ אֲחֹתֵ֕נוּ אַ֥תְּ הֲיִ֖י לְאַלְפֵ֣י רְבָבָ֑ה וְיִירַ֣שׁ זַרְעֵ֔ךְ אֵ֖ת שַׁ֥עַר שֹׂנְאָֽיו׃

controles.web: They blessed Rebekah, and said to her, “Our sister, may you be the mother of thousands of ten thousands, and let your seed possess the gate of those who hate them.”
controles.kjv: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her, Thou art our sister, be thou the mother of thousands of millions, and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them.
controles.livre: E abençoaram a Rebeca, e disseram-lhe: És nossa irmã; sejas em milhares de milhares, e tua geração possua a porta de seus inimigos.

versos.hebraico: וַתָּ֨קָם רִבְקָ֜ה וְנַעֲרֹתֶ֗יהָ וַתִּרְכַּ֨בְנָה֙ עַל־הַגְּמַלִּ֔ים וַתֵּלַ֖כְנָה אַחֲרֵ֣י הָאִ֑ישׁ וַיִּקַּ֥ח הָעֶ֛בֶד אֶת־רִבְקָ֖ה וַיֵּלַֽךְ׃

controles.web: Rebekah arose with her ladies. They rode on the camels, and followed the man. The servant took Rebekah, and went his way.
controles.kjv: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.
controles.livre: Levantou-se então Rebeca e suas moças, e subiram sobre os camelos, e seguiram ao homem; e o criado tomou a Rebeca, e foi embora.

versos.hebraico: וְיִצְחָק֙ בָּ֣א מִבּ֔וֹא בְּאֵ֥ר לַחַ֖י רֹאִ֑י וְה֥וּא יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּאֶ֥רֶץ הַנֶּֽגֶב׃

controles.web: Isaac came from the way of Beer Lahai Roi, for he lived in the land of the South.
controles.kjv: And Isaac came from the way of the well Lahai–roi; for he dwelt in the south country.
controles.livre: E vinha Isaque do poço do Vivente que me vê; porque ele habitava na terra do Sul;

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּצֵ֥א יִצְחָ֛ק לָשׂ֥וּחַ בַּשָּׂדֶ֖ה לִפְנ֣וֹת עָ֑רֶב וַיִּשָּׂ֤א עֵינָיו֙ וַיַּ֔רְא וְהִנֵּ֥ה גְמַלִּ֖ים בָּאִֽים׃

controles.web: Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the evening. He lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, there were camels coming.
controles.kjv: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, the camels were coming.
controles.livre: E havia saído Isaque a orar ao campo, à hora da tarde; e levantando seus olhos, olhou, e eis os camelos que vinham.

versos.hebraico: וַתִּשָּׂ֤א רִבְקָה֙ אֶת־עֵינֶ֔יהָ וַתֵּ֖רֶא אֶת־יִצְחָ֑ק וַתִּפֹּ֖ל מֵעַ֥ל הַגָּמָֽל׃

controles.web: Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she dismounted from the camel.
controles.kjv: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she lighted off the camel.
controles.livre: Rebeca também levantou seus olhos, e viu a Isaque, e desceu do camelo;

versos.hebraico: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל־הָעֶ֗בֶד מִֽי־הָאִ֤ישׁ הַלָּזֶה֙ הַהֹלֵ֤ךְ בַּשָּׂדֶה֙ לִקְרָאתֵ֔נוּ וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הָעֶ֖בֶד ה֣וּא אֲדֹנִ֑י וַתִּקַּ֥ח הַצָּעִ֖יף וַתִּתְכָּֽס׃

controles.web: She said to the servant, “Who is the man who is walking in the field to meet us?”   The servant said, “It is my master.”   She took her veil, and covered herself.
controles.kjv: For she had said unto the servant, What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us? And the servant had said, It is my master: therefore she took a vail, and covered herself.
controles.livre: Porque havia perguntado ao criado: Quem é este homem que vem pelo campo até nós? E o servo havia respondido: Este é meu senhor. Ela então tomou o véu, e cobriu-se.

versos.hebraico: וַיְסַפֵּ֥ר הָעֶ֖בֶד לְיִצְחָ֑ק אֵ֥ת כָּל־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה׃

controles.web: The servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.
controles.kjv: And the servant told Isaac all things that he had done.
controles.livre: Então o criado contou a Isaque tudo o que havia feito.

versos.hebraico: וַיְבִאֶ֣הָ יִצְחָ֗ק הָאֹ֨הֱלָה֙ שָׂרָ֣ה אִמּ֔וֹ וַיִּקַּ֧ח אֶת־רִבְקָ֛ה וַתְּהִי־ל֥וֹ לְאִשָּׁ֖ה וַיֶּאֱהָבֶ֑הָ וַיִּנָּחֵ֥ם יִצְחָ֖ק אַחֲרֵ֥י אִמּֽוֹ׃פ

controles.web: Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife. He loved her. Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.
controles.kjv: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.
controles.livre: E trouxe-a Isaque à tenda de sua mãe Sara, e tomou a Rebeca por mulher; e amou-a: e consolou-se Isaque depois da morte de sua mãe.
